items.text: Edward Jones attributes downward trend in net new assets to higher asset outflows, which are impacted by an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm, among other factors.

The net new asset decrease was attributable to existing clients.

items.text: Edward Jones states the year-to-date decline in net new assets reflects elevated asset outflows influenced by an aging client base and generational wealth transfers outside the firm.
items.quote: This year to date decline reflects elevated asset outflows, which were partially offset by stronger inflows. The outflows relative to the prior-year period continue an increasing downward trend influenced by several factors, including an aging client base, generational wealth transfers outside the firm, macroeconomic volatility, inflationary pressures, and shifts in consumer spending.
